transactions.citation: p33 Significant Events: 'Acquired at 9.1% below valuation'; appraised value JPY2,690.00m by Enrix Co., Ltd as at 31 Dec 2024 (audited property card p.27 / portfolio-statement footnote (4)); purchase price JPY2,446.2m.
transactions.notes: Newly-built freehold nursing home in Osaka, completed 7 Aug 2024, fully funded by JPY debt. DISCLOSED acquisition discount-to-valuation: -9.1% (AR's own wording). Computed check in JPY (to avoid FX-date distortion): (2,446.2m-2,690.0m)/2,690.0m = -9.06%, consistent with the disclosed -9.1%. Sign convention: negative = acquired below independent valuation (discount to the REIT, favourable). Purchase price also quoted as approx S$20.7m (p.33, acquisition-date FX) / approx S$22.1m (audited p.145 footnote, differing FX date); audited Portfolio Statement carrying value at 31 Dec 2024 = S$23.268m. SGD comparison not used as reference_value because of FX-date distortion between the acquisition-date and year-end conversions; JPY (same-date, like-for-like) figures used instead.

transactions.citation: p33-34 Significant Events/Financial Review; audited footnote p.145: exact purchase price EUR111,241,178 (approximately S$157.1 million); audited Portfolio Statement France subtotal S$163.107 million (11 property rows, p.143).
transactions.notes: 11 freehold nursing homes in France, 42,631 sqm, 850 beds, leased to DomusVi under 12-year leases; announced 22 Oct 2024, completed 20 Dec 2024. Not disclosed as a %, so DERIVED = (audited purchase price S$157,100k - portfolio-statement valuation S$163,107k)/S$163,107k = -3.68% (acquired below the France-portfolio carrying valuation). Funded principally by a S$180.0m private placement (p.34 use-of-proceeds S$159.9m allocated to this acquisition, an acquisition-FX-date figure - using this alt purchase price of S$159.9m instead gives -1.97%; not used as primary because it is not the audited FS-note figure). France not split into 11 separate rows because the AR discloses this primarily as a single portfolio-level transaction (Significant Events narrative and Financial Review); per-property carrying values are in properties.json (Portfolio Statement), not property_transactions.
